students.title: Students
students.description: Create student accounts, set their level and section, update their details or archive them.

empty.title: No students yet
empty.description: Add the first student or import the list from a file.

form.createDescription: The student sets up their sign-in through an invitation sent to their email address.

errors.firstName: First name must be at least 2 characters.
errors.lastName: Last name must be at least 2 characters.
errors.schoolNumber: The school number must be 3–10 digits.
errors.duplicateSchoolNumber: This school number belongs to another student.
errors.gradeMismatch: This grade does not belong to the selected level.

archive.title: Archive this student?
archive.message: {{name}} will be archived. Past exam results are kept, but the account can no longer sign in and won't appear in class lists.

dashboard.title: Your institution on one screen.
dashboard.description: Manage users, classes and question imports.

pdf.title: PDF question import
pdf.help: Uploaded PDFs are processed on the server; every question needs your approval before it is used.
pdf.lead: Upload LGS, TYT and AYT PDFs.
pdf.description: Questions in your PDFs are read by AI, split, classified and presented for your approval.

settings.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.description: Add teacher accounts, edit their subject areas and deactivate them when needed.
teachers.formHint: The teacher sets a password on first sign-in.
teachers.deactivateMessage: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in. Their content and exam results are kept.
teachers.activateMessage: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

import.title: Bulk import
import.description: Add student or teacher lists from a CSV file. Every row is checked before saving.
import.rulesStudents: Class must look like "8-A". School number and email must be unique.
import.rulesTeachers: Subject area must be one of the system list. Email must be unique.
import.fileHint: Up to 5 MB and 2,000 rows. Save from Excel as "CSV UTF-8".

errors.empty: No data rows found after the header.
errors.tooMany: A file may contain at most {{max}} rows. Split the file and upload again.

import.previewEmpty: Rows are checked here once you choose a file.
import.previewHint: First choose a CSV file on the left. You can start from the template.
import.skipNote_one: {{count}} row with issues will be skipped.
import.skipNote_other: {{count}} rows with issues will be skipped.

done.body: New accounts set a password on first sign-in. You can review them in the list.

terms.title: School years & terms
terms.description: Create terms and set the active one. Results of past terms stay in the archive.
terms.activateMessage: {{term}} becomes the active term; the current one is archived. No results are deleted.
terms.name: Term name

classes.title: Classes & sections
classes.description: Manage sections, watch class sizes and transfer students.
classes.transferNote: The student’s past results and assignments are kept.

subjects.title: Subjects & topics
subjects.description: Organise the subject catalogue by level and grade. Topics are used in exam analysis.
subjects.noUnits: No units in this subject yet.
subjects.name: Subject name
subjects.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Past results linked to it show as "other" in reports.

assignments.title: Teacher assignments
assignments.description: Assign a teacher to each class subject. The teacher automatically sees the class roster.
assignments.modalHint: Teachers matching the subject area are listed.
assignments.showAll: Show teachers from all subject areas
assignments.noCandidates: No active teacher in this subject area. You can show all.

pdf.title: PDF upload
pdf.description: Upload LGS, TYT and AYT booklets. The server reads, splits and classifies the questions; each question enters the archive only after your approval.
pdf.fileHint: PDF only, up to 25 MB. At least 300 dpi is recommended for scans.
pdf.pipelineHint: AI suggestions always go through human review; no question is published automatically.
pdf.demoNote: In demo mode the file is not sent to a server; the processing steps are simulated.

review.title: Question review
review.description: Check the questions extracted from PDFs, correct them if needed and approve.
review.emptyPendingHint: Questions appear here after you upload a PDF.
review.figureWarning: This question has a figure. Check in the PDF that it was cropped correctly.

done.approved: This question was approved and added to the archive.
done.rejected: This question was rejected and not added to the archive.

approved.title: Approved questions
approved.description: Approved exam questions; teachers use this archive for mock exams and topic tests.
approved.question: Question
approved.archived: Question archived; it won’t be suggested for new exams.

processing.title: Processing status
processing.description: Track queued, processing and failed uploads.
processing.note: The list refreshes itself every few seconds while files are processing.

schools.title: High schools
schools.description: High school base scores and quotas used by the preference assistant.
schools.deleteMessage: {{name}} will be removed from the preference assistant. Saved entries in student lists show as "no longer available".

universities.title: Universities & programs
universities.description: Base ranks, scores and quotas used by the preference robot and programme suggestions.
universities.deleteMessage: {{name}} will be removed from the preference robot.

careers.title: Careers & skills
careers.description: Career information used by career suggestions and the roadmap.
careers.name: Career name
careers.deleteMessage: {{name}} will be removed from career suggestions.

dataUpdates.title: Data updates
dataUpdates.description: Update guidance data with files from official sources.
dataUpdates.uploadHint: The new file replaces the current dataset; the old version is kept in history.
dataUpdates.fileHint: CSV, up to 10 MB. The first row must contain column headers.
dataUpdates.serverNote: The server validates the file; invalid rows are reported and skipped.

support.title: Support requests
support.description: Reply to and track issues reported by teachers and students.
support.subject: Subject

usage.title: Platform usage
usage.description: Weekly active users, exams and uploads.
usage.trendAria: Line chart of weekly active students and exams taken
usage.activeDefinition: Active: signed in at least once in the last 7 days.

aiUsage.title: AI usage
aiUsage.description: Number and cost of AI operations and share of the monthly budget.
aiUsage.demoNote: Operation counts and costs shown in demo mode are sample values.
aiUsage.dailyAria: Daily AI operations over the last 30 days

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what and when — every change is traceable.
audit.note: Entries are stored on the server and cannot be changed here.

institution.title: Institution
institution.description: School name, contact details, logo and academic settings.
institution.name: Institution name
institution.shortHint: Up to 6 characters; used on small screens.
institution.httpsOnly: The address must start with https://.
institution.logoHint: Shown on sign-in and in reports.
institution.logoFileHint: PNG, JPG or WEBP; up to 1 MB, square recommended.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Choose what teachers and students may do.
permissions.serverNote: Permissions are enforced on the server; this screen only edits the rules. Locked rules cannot be changed for security reasons.
permissions.adminNote: Administrator permissions are always on so the institution can never lock itself out.

hints.createStudents: Accounts are opened only by the school administration.
hints.moveStudents: Change class while keeping past results.
hints.viewStudentProfiles: Teachers only see their own classes.
hints.generateWithAi: Summaries, questions and slides; subject to daily limits.
hints.shareContent: Shared content is visible to the class.
hints.createExams: Create quizzes, written exams and homework.
hints.useArchive: Add approved LGS/YKS questions to exams.
hints.studentMockExams: Students can take mock exams on their own.
hints.messageStudents: One-to-one messages with students in the class.
hints.studentMessaging: Students can only write to their own teachers.
hints.publishAnnouncements: Teachers can announce to their own classes.

aiSettings.title: AI settings
aiSettings.description: Provider connection, usage limits and enabled features.
aiSettings.keyPolicy: The key is sent only to the server and stored encrypted there. It is never kept in the browser or shown again; only its last 4 characters are visible.
aiSettings.keyDemo: In demo mode the key is not sent anywhere and is discarded immediately.
aiSettings.testFail: Could not connect. Check the key.

featureHints.summaries: Topic summaries from PDFs for teachers.
featureHints.guidance: Programme and career explanations for students.

aiSettings.reviewNote: AI output is always published only after teacher or administrator approval.

integrations.title: Integrations & notifications
integrations.description: Meeting service, email and notification preferences.
integrations.meetingsHint: Meetings created by teachers open on this service.
integrations.oauthNote: The service account is configured on the server; secrets are never shown here.
integrations.emailEnabledHint: When off, only in-app notifications are sent.
integrations.smtpNote: SMTP credentials are stored in server environment variables.
integrations.notificationsHint: Choose the channel for each event.

retention.title: Archive & retention
retention.description: Set how long personal data is kept and how backups run.
retention.periodsHint: Expired data is anonymised or deleted automatically on the server.
retention.kvkk: Periods must match your institution’s data policy under the Turkish data protection law (KVKK).
retention.backupDemo: No real backup is taken in demo mode.
retention.restoreNote: Restores are performed only by the server administrator.
